headline.zh: 图书与咖啡的先驱复合空间
headline.en: Pioneer of books and coffee combo

traits.zh: 橡木书架顶天立地，哲学区与诗集区挨着咖啡吧台
traits.en: Tall oak bookshelves, philosophy and poetry near the bar

traits.zh: 特色饮品‘鲁迅拿铁’（黑巧+浓缩+手冲冷萃）
traits.en: Special drink: Lu Xun Latte (dark choc + espresso + cold brew)

traits.zh: 工作日下午2–4点人少、光影柔，店主愿聊书
traits.en: Quiet, soft light, and chat with owner 2-4pm on weekdays

traits.zh: 由著名摄影师尔冬强创建，当年开风气之先
traits.en: Founded by renowned photographer Er Dongqiang, a trendsetter

focus.en: Good for focused reading and chats
